title: Tim Dooley Science & Mathematics — Master Research Index
status: canonical science navigation and programme layer
purpose: Navigate the project's recovered equations, later mathematical formalizations, established science comparators, measurements, tests and unresolved source archaeology as one coherent research programme. This index no longer tries to be the equation warehouse: detailed formulas live in the equation ledgers and owner papers. The root organizes scientific questions, model families, maturity, measurement requirements, cross-project use and failure boundaries.
master_rule: Scientific usefulness increases when a model distinguishes cases that prose had conflated, connects latent variables to observations, competes with a baseline, survives unit/uncertainty checks and can return a negative result. Mathematics is not evidence merely because it resembles Potatoverse symbolism.

research_programmes.question: Does a boundary protect differentiated function while preserving legitimate passage, or does it convert protection into opaque dependency/capture?
research_programmes.key_result: Closedness and openness have no fixed moral sign. Low permeability can protect or imprison; high permeability can enable exchange or destroy privacy. Exit, selectivity, capability, objective and harm decide the empirical interpretation.
research_programmes.largest_gap: domain-specific threat models and measured exit/portability data

research_programmes.question: How can one rooted source differentiate into many descendants while preserving auditability and generative capability?
research_programmes.key_result: Branch count measures proliferation, not truth or generativity. A healthy research Tree requires both descendant capability and recoverable lineage to roots.
research_programmes.largest_gap: apply the metrics to the repository graph and compare traceability/correction propagation with simpler indexing

research_programmes.question: When does many-to-one synthesis create perspective rather than destructive flattening?
research_programmes.key_result: A useful summit is not maximum accumulation or shortest summary; it is a compact representation that preserves task-relevant information, uncertainty and a descent path to evidence.
research_programmes.largest_gap: benchmark hierarchical Mountain summaries on source recovery, contradiction discovery and prediction/decision tasks

research_rules: Do not backdate archive equations or external theories into Tim's earlier authorship without primary evidence.
Preserve historically recovered equations exactly; technical repairs live in descendant models.
Do not collapse mathematical similarity into physical identity or theological proof.
Every promoted physical model must define variables, units, domain, assumptions, dynamics, observations, uncertainty, baseline and falsifier.
Use dimensionless groups before combining dimensional quantities into critical thresholds.
Cross-scale explanations require an explicit channel/coarse-graining map and an error budget.
Cross-domain analogies should state the transformation and the operation/invariant preserved, plus a mismatch/failure statement.
For physical celestial claims declare frame, epoch, Axis vector, observer/time where required and angular tolerance before testing.
Do not infer evidential strength from visibility, attention, centrality, connectivity or proliferation alone.
For Garden/center claims, distinguish temporary supported output from durable capability after support reduction/removal.
For counter-rotation distinguish mean and relative coordinates; zero mean drift is not zero activity.
For House/Shell, openness or closedness alone is insufficient; measure selective flow, exit, portability, privacy, objective and harm.
For Tree, branch count is not generativity; record provenance and descendant capability.
For Mountain, compression ratio is not perspective; track task/reconstruction/provenance loss.
Allow scientific models to return negative results and preserve them in the archive.
If data cannot identify all model parameters, record underdetermination rather than selecting a preferred symbolic interpretation.
Assign science-like Timic ideas maturity T0-T5 so symbolic importance is never confused with empirical maturity.
